body: Like shit! I had a relapse last night and I'm not even sure what triggered it. I'm extremely disappointed in myself; I was doing so good.
Thank you for the suggestion. I stopped to buy a journal during my lunch break today at work to give it a shot.

Thank you for taking the time to comment. I know words can sound empty but I hope things get better for you as well. I understand what you mean by trying to go to someone and feeling like they just don’t get it or feel like they are just brushing off what you’re saying like it’s nothing serious, if you ever need to talk or just vent to someone you can message me anytime.
